record.question: To flog a dead horse
options: to try to achieve an impossible thing
to beat a horse that is dead
to retrieve interest in a subject which is out of date
record.explanation: Answer A: to try to achieve an impossible thing. To flog a dead horse is to persist in a futile or pointless effort; A is the closest of the printed choices. Independent check: “Flog a dead horse” means continue an effort that is futile; option A is the closest listed paraphrase. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/flog-a-dead-horse. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
